clare_cs: HarborLane onboarding - trial flagged: p95 ~560ms, token spend +40% vs forecast. Customer concerned about renewal. Any low-risk plays?

ash_sre: Quick q: model + streaming? bulk vs interactive?

clare_cs: redwood-1-standard-v2, streaming=true for UI, bulk nightly jobs too. avg prompt 95 tokens, max_tokens 200.

mason_ml: Two-pronged: 1) prefix caching for UI templates 2) 48h 12% canary to compact-int8 for background jobs. Compact usually <2% quality drop on summarization.

ash_sre: I'll add routing rule scoped to job_type=background. YAML snippet:

```yaml
canary:
  id: 4987654321
  duration_hours: 48
  traffic_split:
    - selector: job_type=="background"
      model: redwood-1-compact-int8-v2
      percent: 12
    - selector: default
      model: redwood-1-standard-v2
      percent: 88
cache:
  prefix_cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl_seconds: 600
safety:
  rollback_if: semantic_similarity_drop>0.03
metrics: [p95_latency,tokens_per_request,semantic_similarity]
```

clare_cs: Nice. Customer SLOs: p95<420ms, accuracy >98.5%. I'll get their sample corpus and permission for evals.

mason_ml: We'll run the eval harness, post diffs, and watch for topic drift. If any prompt families fail, we can route those back to standard-v2 via tag filtering.

ops-bot: Canary started: 12% -> redwood-1-compact-int8-v2. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/4987654321

clare_cs: Scheduling 24h sync. Also capturing customer feedback form link to attach to evals. Thanks team! :sparkles:
